title: AAT Architecten hero
description: A quiet white opening: one statement in a 24–40px grotesk, a small 'scroll' cue at the bottom-left, and a single tall portrait photo. On phones the photo sits right of centre under the text; from 1024px the block fills the window and the photo stands at the right edge, nearly the window's full height. The photo wipes up into view on load, and on phones it is cropped away from the top as it scrolls off.
notes: from 1024px it is exactly the window's height and leaves room at the top for an overlaid header (aat-architecten-header)
the load wipe starts after 0.9s, timed to follow aat-architecten-loader; pass revealDelay={0} without it
the photo slot is a muted placeholder until you pass media (an with object-cover fills it)
name: aat-architecten-hero

props.name: statement
props.description: the one statement, a sentence or two

props.name: scrollLabel
props.description: the small cue at the bottom-left (e.g. "scroll")

props.name: media
props.description: the photo (an with object-cover fills the frame); empty: a muted placeholder

props.name: revealDelay
props.description: seconds before the photo wipes in on load (0.9 follows aat-architecten-loader)
